main_text.l: Sacramentum pœnitentiæ ejusque ceremoniæ apud Maronitas. 477
Arabicá lingvá pro vulgari hodiè utuntur[?].
in urbe Sichem & in Ægypto commoran-tium ad Jos. Scaligerum epistolæ. 29

page.notes: Scan is blurred in places. Doubtful readings: "utuntur" (line after "lingvá", possibly "uruntur" in print), "130" after "Samaritanorum lex." (could be 150), and "lingvá" accent. The "seq"/"seqq" abbreviations are printed with a long-s form that reads like "f"; transcribed as plain s. "Mofis" in the print is read as "Mosis". Ornamental marks at the left edge and scan specks are not printed text.
